exclusions: The repaired target state, canonical ledger, active discussions, live revisit queue, rejected state, discoveries, both target-local inspiration files, publication state and global utility ledger were audited first. UTF-8 and JSON integrity checks passed; no objective defect, active listener authorization, triggered revisit or open workflow repair required REPAIR.

Every canonical, previously evaluated, active PARKED, placement-specific REJECT and previously unresolved exact artist/title identity was excluded. This includes Run 259's DJ Carpenter and Shcuro/Vil/YUNX identities, Run 260's Picture/Hiss Is Bliss/Colomboi identities, and all Sa Pa Rhythm From Ambient titles already unresolved in Run 236.

Repair Run 261's evidence-quality guard was applied: these nine leads come from nine distinct releases, each with exact-track evidence or exact-single framing; no shared release description was multiplied into multiple candidates.

Candidate boundaries differ from the last three EXPLORE runs. No placement splits or reorders Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer; the proposed Menson boundary is before Transparency and therefore outside the two protected internal handoffs.

Individual descriptions remain attributed prose, not measurements. No wording was converted into inferred energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, mixability or transition quality. Rank reflects evidence specificity, fit hypothesis and information gain rather than novelty, genre orthodoxy, artist diversity, technical cleverness or a fixed chapter map.
